deny: Command denied ({reason}). A person must run it, outside Claude Code.
blockedEnv: Command blocked: "{target}" designates a TEST/STAGING/PROD environment. Agents operate only on DEV; TEST, STAGING and PROD are reached only through the release pipeline.
notDev: Command blocked: environment "{target}" is not the project DEV environment ({dev}). Pass the DEV URL or ID declared in CLAUDE.md.
releaseProd: Command blocked: a release to PROD/production is started by a person, not by an agent.
profileBlocked: Command blocked: the active pac profile points to TEST/STAGING/PROD ({profile}). Select the DEV profile with "pac auth select" or pass --environment.
profileNotDev: Command blocked: the active pac profile ({profile}) is not the project DEV environment ({dev}). Select the DEV profile or pass --environment.
noSolution: Command blocked: no solution specified. Add {hint}. No component may live outside the project solution.
noStoryRef: Commit blocked: no work item reference in the message (e.g. "feat: ... {example}"). Always work on a story with an ID.
commitNoMessage: Commit blocked: pass the message with -m or -F (no editor), including the work item reference (e.g. "{example}").
ask: Confirmation required: {reason}. Check environment, solution and version before approving.
mcpBlockedEnv: MCP call blocked ({tool}): "{target}" designates a TEST/STAGING/PROD environment. Agents operate only on DEV.
mcpNotDev: MCP call blocked ({tool}): "{target}" is not the project DEV environment ({dev}). Use the DEV URL or ID declared in CLAUDE.md.
mcpUnverifiedId: Confirmation required: {tool} targets environment {target}, which cannot be checked because CLAUDE.md declares no DEV ID. Approve only if it is DEV.
mcpAsk: Confirmation required: MCP write operation "{op}" on {server}.
secret: Write blocked ({file}): possible {kind}. Use environment variables, Key Vault, pipeline secrets or connection references. False positive? Add the comment "pp-kit:allow-secret" on that line, or (JSON files) a secretAllowFiles pattern in ~/.claude/hooks/pp-kit/config.json.
stopReminder: pp-kit: {missing} not yet run on the current state of the code.
missingRulesSection: The result has no "### Rules applied" section. Add it (IDs of the rules followed, or "No applicable rule - assumption: ..."), together with "### Assumptions and decisions" and "### Files changed".
sessionNoStory: Branch "{branch}" has no story ID: before changing code, ask for the user story ID (/story <ID>).
sessionNoStoryDir: docs/stories/{id}/ does not exist yet: run /story {id} for spec and plan.
sessionOpenDecisions: Open DECISIONS of the story ({n}) - do not proceed on these points:
sessionNoOpenDecisions: No open DECISION of the story recorded locally.
doctorNoProject: Folder outside a pp-kit project (CLAUDE.md): logins not compared with DEV.
doctorNoDev: DEV environment not filled in CLAUDE.md: logins not compared with DEV.
doctorLoginMissing: {name}: no login or expired – the product owner runs: {hint}
doctorLoginNotDev: {name}: no profile for DEV {dev} – the product owner runs: {hint}
doctorOneDrive: Clone inside OneDrive ({repo}): syncing breaks git (.git/logs, index). Clone into a short folder outside OneDrive, e.g. C:\r\<repo>.
doctorLongPath: Long clone path ({n} characters, max {max}): risk of paths beyond 260 characters. Use a short folder, worktrees in C:\t\wt-<sprint>.
doctorGitSetting: git {key} is not {value} – run doctor.cjs --fix or: git config {key} {value}
doctorNoGit: Folder outside a git repository: git checks skipped.
doctorRam: RAM {total} GB, free {free} GB (recommended ≥ {minTotal} GB, ≥ {minFree} GB free; 32 GB with 3–4 agents). Low memory makes builds and tests flaky: limit agents running builds or tests in parallel.
doctorFailed: doctor: {n} required checks failed. Fix them before starting the sprint.
agentWritePath: Write blocked: agent {agent} may only write its own files ({file} is not an allowed path, config agentWritePaths). Return the content in your result: the orchestrator saves it.
ppUsage:
pp – one-line commands for the main session (node ~/.claude/hooks/pp-kit/pp.cjs):
  commit "<title>" --ab <id>... --checks "<result>" [--ai "<agents>"] [--files <f>...] [--push] [--dry-run]
  task <story> <task> <state> [--note "<text>"]
  decisions open
  decisions close <id>[-<id>]=<option>... [--reject <id>...] --quote "<answer of the product owner>" --by "<person>" [--ado] [--ado-state <state>] [--dry-run]
  ado comment <id> (--file <f.md> | --text "<markdown>")   ·   ado state <id> <state>
  stats <transcript.jsonl>
ppUsageClose: Usage: pp decisions close <id>[-<id>]=<option>... [--reject <id>...] --quote "<answer of the product owner>" --by "<person>"
ppUsageAdo: Usage: pp ado comment <id> (--file <f.md> | --text "<markdown>")  or  pp ado state <id> <state>
ppNoRef: Commit refused: story reference missing (--ab <id> or {example} in the title).
ppNoChecks: Commit refused: state the checks that were run with --checks "<command> → <result>" (or "none", if so).
ppPullFailed: pull --rebase failed ({err}): resolve the conflicts, then git push.
ppBadState: State "{state}" is not valid; allowed states: {states}
ppNoOpen: No open decisions in the project register.
ppOpenHint: {n} open decisions. The product owner answers by ID, e.g. "approve 1608–1614 A, 1616 C".
ppNeedQuote: Close refused: --quote "<verbatim answer of the product owner>" and --by "<person>" are required.
ppQuoteNoApproval: Close refused for #{id}: the quoted answer must approve explicitly and name the ID or the option (or "approve all"). If it is ambiguous, ask the product owner which IDs.
ppTwice: Close refused: IDs given more than once ({ids}). Every decision has one outcome.
ppNoAdo: Azure DevOps organization or project not found in CLAUDE.md: pass --org and --project.
ppNoToken: No Azure DevOps token: set ADO_TOKEN or run az login (the product owner does).
ppStatsMcp: MCP: {n} calls, ~{tokens} tokens of responses in context (tool, calls, tokens)
ppStatsShell: Shell: {commits} commits, {scripts} ad-hoc scripts, {blocks} hook blocks; most frequent commands:
